text: Kripke semantics for IPC uses a partially ordered set of 'worlds' (stages of knowledge). Validity of A∨B at world w requires:
choices: A is valid at w or B is valid at w
A is valid at some world accessible from w
A is valid at all worlds accessible from w or B is at all such worlds
A is valid or B is valid but not both
explanation: In Kripke semantics: w ⊩ A∨B iff w ⊩ A or w ⊩ B (unlike ¬, ∀ which involve all accessible worlds).
